simple.prompt: Formal opening salutation when recipient's name is unknown: '___,'
options: Dear Sir or Madam
Hey there
Hello friend
simple.explanation: Dalam korespondensi bisnis resmi tradisional bahasa Inggris, jika nama penerima tidak diketahui, gunakan 'Dear Sir or Madam,' (diakhiri 'Yours faithfully,').
hints: Salam pembuka resmi tradisional jika nama tidak diketahui.
Gunakan 'Dear Sir or Madam'.

simple.prompt: Stating the purpose of writing: 'I am writing to ___ clarification regarding the proposed restructuring.'
options: request
ask for
get
simple.explanation: Gunakan 'request' sebagai padanan resmi dalam pembuka surat bisnis: 'I am writing to request clarification...'.
hints: Kata kerja formal meminta klarifikasi.
Gunakan 'request'.

simple.targetSentence: Please find attached the finalized quarterly expenditure report.
simple.explanation: Please find attached + the finalized quarterly expenditure report.
hints: Formula lampiran baku: 'Please find attached'.
Objek lampiran: 'the finalized quarterly expenditure report'.

simple.prompt: Formal closing sign-off when addressing someone by name ('Dear Ms. Jenkins,'): '___,'
options: Yours sincerely
Yours faithfully
Best vibes
simple.explanation: Aturan korespondensi baku British/Commonwealth: Jika menyapa dengan nama ('Dear Ms. Jenkins'), penutupnya adalah 'Yours sincerely,'. Jika tanpa nama ('Dear Sir/Madam'), penutupnya adalah 'Yours faithfully,'.
hints: Pasangan salam pembuka bernama (Dear Ms. Jenkins).
Gunakan 'Yours sincerely'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat formal permohonan tindak lanjut.
simple.targetSentence: I would appreciate your prompt response regarding this matter.
simple.explanation: I would appreciate + your prompt response regarding this matter.
hints: Mulai dengan 'I would appreciate'.
Permohonan sopan: 'your prompt response regarding this matter'.

options: EXECUTIVE
GENERAL
TOP LEVEL
simple.explanation: Judul standar dokumen laporan manajerial resmi adalah 'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY'.
hints: Judul standar ringkasan eksekutif laporan.
Gunakan 'EXECUTIVE'.

simple.targetSentence: This report examines the feasibility of expanding our operations.
simple.explanation: This report examines + the feasibility of expanding our operations.
hints: Mulai dengan 'This report examines'.
Tujuan laporan: 'the feasibility of expanding our operations'.

simple.prompt: When you open a formal letter with 'Dear Mr. Hartono,', which complimentary close matches British and international business conventions?
options: Yours sincerely,
Yours faithfully,
Best wishes forever,
simple.explanation: Aturan klasik korespondensi: jika nama penerima DISEBUTKAN ('Dear Mr. Hartono,'), tutup dengan 'Yours sincerely,' atau 'Sincerely,'; 'Yours faithfully,' khusus bila nama penerima tidak diketahui ('Dear Sir or Madam,').
hints: Nama penerima disebutkan secara eksplisit ('Mr. Hartono').
Dengan nama → 'Yours sincerely'; tanpa nama → 'Yours faithfully'.

simple.prompt: Which opening line states the purpose of a formal inquiry email most professionally?
options: I am writing to inquire about group registration rates for the November summit.
I just wanted to drop a quick line wondering how much tickets cost.
Hey, please tell me right now what the group rates are.
simple.explanation: Formula baku pembuka email bisnis resmi untuk tujuan bertanya: 'I am writing to inquire about...'.
hints: Cari pembuka email yang jelas, ringkas, dan sopan.
Hindari 'Hey' atau 'drop a quick line' dalam konteks resmi.

simple.prompt: Choose the standard formal phrase used to direct a recipient to an attached PDF file:
options: Please find attached the quarterly expense summary for your review.
Here is the PDF thing I stuck onto this email.
Look down below for the file I attached just now.
simple.explanation: 'Please find attached...' atau 'I have attached...' adalah formula standar dan elegan dalam korespondensi profesional.
hints: Hindari ungkapan kasual seperti 'PDF thing' atau 'stuck onto'.
Gunakan formula standar 'Please find attached...'.

simple.prompt: Which heading belongs inside an executive business report rather than a casual chat?
options: 2. Key Findings and Budget Implications
Stuff We Found Out Lately
Why Things Went Kinda Wrong
simple.explanation: Judul subbab laporan (report headings) harus ringkas, nominalisasi terstruktur, dan netral ('Key Findings and Budget Implications').
hints: Report heading memakai frasa nomina padat tanpa slang.
Pilih heading paling profesional.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi penutup email formal yang berisi ajakan tindakan sopan (call to action).
dialogue: Sender
We have prepared two options for the logistics schedule.
Closer
___ your preferred delivery window by Thursday afternoon so we can lock in the carrier.
options: Could you please confirm
Answer me fast about
You better pick
simple.explanation: 'Could you please confirm...' atau 'We would appreciate it if you could confirm...' menjaga nada kerjasama yang santun sekaligus tegas soal tenggat.
hints: Ajakan tindakan harus sopan namun jelas batas waktunya.
Pilih formula 'Could you please confirm'.

simple.prompt: In a formal business report, where do 'Recommendations' normally appear in standard report order?
options: Near the end, following Findings and Conclusions
Before the Title Page and Terms of Reference
Inside the email subject line
simple.explanation: Urutan baku laporan resmi: Title/Executive Summary → Introduction (Terms of Reference) → Methodology/Findings → Conclusions → Recommendations.
hints: Rekomendasi disusun setelah analisis temuan dan kesimpulan.
Letaknya di bagian akhir laporan.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan sapaan tanpa nama dan penutup surat yang tidak cocok berikut.
simple.draft: Dear Sir or Madam, Please find enclosed our revised compliance tender. Yours sincerely, Farhan
options: Dear Sir or Madam, Please find enclosed our revised compliance tender. Yours faithfully, Farhan
Dear Sir or Madam, Please find enclosed our revised compliance tender. Yours truly best, Farhan
Dear Sir, Enclosed is our tender. Warm hugs, Farhan
simple.explanation: Karena pembuka tidak menyebut nama orang ('Dear Sir or Madam,'), penutup tradisional resminya adalah 'Yours faithfully,' (bukan 'Yours sincerely,').
hints: Periksa aturan pasangan 'Dear Sir or Madam' → 'Yours faithfully'.
Ganti 'Yours sincerely' menjadi 'Yours faithfully'.

simple.prompt: Which introductory phrase fits the opening of a formal feasibility report?
options: The purpose of this report is to evaluate two solar microgrid proposals.
In this short write-up I wanna talk about solar panels.
Let's check out if solar grids are worth doing.
simple.explanation: 'The purpose of this report is to evaluate...' adalah kalimat pembuka klasik dan lugas untuk laporan analitis.
hints: Pembuka laporan memakai nada objektif dan kata kerja evaluatif presisi.
Pilih 'The purpose of this report is to evaluate...'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat penutup sopan menawarkan bantuan lanjutan di email bisnis.
simple.targetSentence: Should you have any questions regarding the contract terms, please do not hesitate to contact us.
simple.explanation: Formula baku penutup email resmi memakai inversi sopan 'Should you have any questions...'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Should you have any questions regarding the contract terms,'.
Akhiri dengan 'please do not hesitate to contact us'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat rekomendasi laporan formal menggunakan modal 'should' atau 'is recommended'.
simple.targetSentence: It is recommended that regional warehouses install automated temperature loggers prior to summer.
simple.explanation: Formula rekomendasi laporan memakai impersonal 'It is recommended that + S + V1 (subjunctive)'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'It is recommended that regional warehouses'.
Lengkapi V1 subjunctive 'install' dan objeknya.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog penyampaian kabar buruk dalam korespondensi resmi.
dialogue: Manager
How should we inform the applicant that their grant was rejected?
Coordinator
We should write: 'We ___ to inform you that we are unable to approve your application at this time.'
options: regret
are sad
feel bad
intermediate.explanation: 'We regret to inform you that...' adalah formula diplomatis baku dan bermartabat untuk menyampaikan keputusan negatif dalam korespondensi resmi.
hints: Formula baku penyampaian keputusan negatif.
Gunakan 'regret'.

intermediate.prompt: Executive report recommendations section formula: 'It is strongly ___ that management commission an independent audit.'
options: recommended
demanded
suggested unconditionally
intermediate.explanation: Pola pasif rekomendasi laporan formal: 'It is strongly recommended that [subject] + subjunctive base verb...'.
hints: Formula rekomendasi pasif berbobot.
Gunakan 'recommended'.

intermediate.prompt: Offering assistance diplomatically: 'Should you require any further assistance, please do not ___ to contact me.'
options: hesitate
delay
pause
intermediate.explanation: Formula penutup bantuan resmi: 'please do not hesitate to contact me'.
hints: Formula standar penawaran bantuan sopan.
Gunakan 'hesitate'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penyampaian apresiasi atas kerja sama.
intermediate.targetSentence: Thank you for your continued cooperation and support.
intermediate.explanation: Thank you for your continued cooperation and support.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Thank you for your continued'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'cooperation and support'.

intermediate.prompt: Report methodology section heading: 'DATA ___ AND METHODOLOGY'
options: COLLECTION
GATHERING UP
TAKING
intermediate.explanation: 'DATA COLLECTION AND METHODOLOGY' adalah tajuk standar laporan ilmiah dan konsultasi manajemen.
hints: Tajuk formal pengumpulan data riset.
Gunakan 'COLLECTION'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka penyesalan penundaan pengiriman.
intermediate.targetSentence: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by this delay.
intermediate.explanation: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by this delay.
hints: Mulai dengan permohonan maaf resmi: 'We sincerely apologize for'.
Dampak: 'any inconvenience caused by this delay'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tindak lanjut pertemuan bisnis.
dialogue: Client
Will you send a summary of our discussion?
Account Director
Yes, I will transmit the agreed action items ___ of tomorrow's meeting.
options: in the minutes
in the little writings
in the talking notes
intermediate.explanation: 'The minutes of the meeting' (notula rapat) adalah istilah resmi dokumen catatan keputusan pertemuan bisnis.
hints: Istilah resmi notula rapat bisnis.
Gunakan 'in the minutes'.

intermediate.prompt: When delivering negative news diplomatically in a client email (rejecting a discount request), which structure maintains goodwill best?
options: Acknowledge the partnership -> state the refusal neutrally with a clear reason -> offer a constructive alternative
State 'No, your request is denied' in bold red uppercase -> end immediately
Apologize twenty times while blaming the accounting intern by name
intermediate.explanation: Dalam komunikasi bisnis, menyampaikan kabar buruk memakai pendekatan taktis 'buffer (apresiasi) → alasan objektif & penolakan sopan → opsi alternatif' menjaga hubungan jangka panjang tanpa merendahkan pihak mana pun.
hints: Hindari penolakan kasar maupun menyalahkan individu internal.
Gunakan alur diplomatis 3 langkah.

intermediate.prompt: Replace the vague email subject 'Question / Help!' with a crisp, scannable business subject line:
options: Action Required: Approval of Q4 Freight Budget by Oct 18
Read this ASAP please thanks
Quick thing about some money issues
intermediate.explanation: Subjek email bisnis yang efektif langsung mencantumkan jenis tindakan ('Action Required:'), topik spesifik, dan tenggat waktu ('by Oct 18').
hints: Subjek email harus langsung jelas isi dan urgensi waktunya tanpa memaksa.
Pilih format 'Action Required: [Topik] by [Tanggal]'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang menyusun kalimat 'Findings' laporan dengan istilah terukur.
dialogue: Lead
Which verb phrase sounds objective in our warehouse audit findings: 'We noticed lots of delays' or '___'?
Analyst
'Inspection logs indicated that 18% of cold-chain dispatches exceeded the two-hour loading threshold.'
options: specific quantified evidence with neutral reporting verbs
emotional complaints about slow morning crews
unverified rumors from temporary drivers
intermediate.explanation: Laporan resmi tidak memakai kesan emosional ('lots of delays'); ia menyajikan angka persentase terukur dan sumber data spesifik ('Inspection logs indicated...').
hints: Laporan membutuhkan data terukur dan kata kerja pelapor objektif.
Pilih deskripsi temuan faktual berbasis angka.

intermediate.prompt: Choose the tactful diplomatic phrase for requesting overdue invoice payment in a second reminder:
options: We would be grateful if you could arrange settlement of Invoice #408 at your earliest convenience.
Pay us right now before we call our lawyers tomorrow morning.
Why haven't you bothered sending our money since August?
intermediate.explanation: 'We would be grateful if you could arrange settlement...' tetap tegas menagih hak perusahaan namun menjaga citra profesional dan hubungan klien.
hints: Nada surat pengingat tagihan kedua perlu sopan tapi tegas.
Gunakan 'arrange settlement... at your earliest convenience'.

intermediate.prompt: Identify an accurate sentence opening a formal Incident / Crisis Update to stakeholders:
options: We are writing to inform you of a temporary service interruption that occurred earlier today.
Oops! Everything crashed this morning and we are freaking out.
Bad news guys — our server completely blew up around noon.
intermediate.explanation: Komunikasi krisis harus tenang, transparan, menghindari kepanikan, dan membuka dengan formula resmi 'We are writing to inform you of...'.
hints: Komunikasi krisis butuh ketenangan, fakta objektif, dan profesionalisme.
Pilih pembuka resmi yang terukur.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan nada menuntut kasar dan register campuran dalam email tindak lanjut proyek berikut.
intermediate.draft: Hey Mr. Tan, I need the signed blueprints right now because we're already behind, get back to me ASAP!
options: Dear Mr. Tan, We would appreciate receiving the signed blueprints by 3:00 p.m. today so that site mobilization can stay on schedule. Kind regards,
Mr. Tan, Send me the blueprints ASAP because we are super behind right now. Sincerely,
Dear Mr. Tan, You didn't send the blueprints yet, so drop everything and email them. Cheers,
intermediate.explanation: Mengganti perintah kasar ('I need ... right now', 'get back to me ASAP!') dengan 'We would appreciate receiving... by [exact time] so that...' menjelaskan dampak jadwal secara jelas tanpa terdengar agresif.
hints: Ganti 'Hey' dan 'ASAP!' menjadi tenggat spesifik dan alasan operasional yang sopan.
Jaga sapaan dan penutup yang serasi.

intermediate.prompt: When referencing a specific section of an annual report cleanly, use standard report terminology: 'As detailed in ___ 3.2, solar yield peaked in August.'
options: Section / Subsection
Chunk
Bit
intermediate.explanation: Istilah formal untuk bagian laporan adalah 'Section', 'Subsection', atau 'Appendix' (bukan 'Chunk' atau 'Bit').
hints: Gunakan nomenklatur dokumen formal.
Pilih 'Section / Subsection'.

intermediate.prompt: Which sentence closes a formal recommendation section concisely?
options: In light of these cost savings, full migration to LED dock lighting is strongly recommended.
So anyway, buying LED lights is probably a pretty cool idea for us.
I think LEDs might be neat to put up if anyone agrees.
intermediate.explanation: Rekomendasi laporan sebaiknya impersonal dan terhubung langsung ke bukti sebelumnya ('In light of these cost savings, ... is strongly recommended').
hints: Gunakan konstruksi impersonal tegas yang terhubung dengan alasan bukti.
Hindari 'pretty cool' atau 'I think ... neat'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka formal untuk menyampaikan penolakan aplikasi secara sopan.
intermediate.targetSentence: Thank you for your interest; unfortunately, we are unable to offer an internship placement this term.
intermediate.explanation: Mengucapkan terima kasih terlebih dulu diikuti 'unfortunately, we are unable to...' menjaga martabat pelamar.
hints: Awali dengan 'Thank you for your interest;'.
Sambungkan penolakan sopan 'unfortunately, we are unable to...'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pernyataan ruang lingkup dalam pendahuluan laporan (Terms of Reference).
intermediate.targetSentence: This report examines quarterly freight delays across three maritime hubs and proposes mitigation steps.
intermediate.explanation: Kalimat pendahuluan lugas menyatakan cakupan objek ('three maritime hubs') dan tujuannya ('proposes mitigation steps').
hints: Mulai dengan 'This report examines quarterly freight delays'.
Lengkapi ruang lingkup dan tujuannya.

complex.prompt: Koreksi inkonsistensi nada bicara (tone) yang terlalu agresif dalam surat tuntutan kepatuhan.
complex.draft: You guys must pay the invoice immediately or we will drag you to court right now.
options: We respectfully request the immediate settlement of the outstanding invoice, failing which we shall be obliged to instruct our legal counsel to commence recovery proceedings.
Pay the money now because we really need it.
Please send the cash quick so we don't sue you.
complex.explanation: Surat tuntutan hukum resmi mempertahankan kesopanan dingin yang tak tergoyahkan (unflinching polite restraint): 'We respectfully request the immediate settlement..., failing which we shall be obliged to instruct our legal counsel...'.
hints: Gunakan bahasa hukum yang tenang, tegas, dan berwibawa.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Structure of a formal investigative report: What is the normative order of sections?
options: Executive Summary -> Introduction -> Methodology -> Findings -> Discussion -> Recommendations
Recommendations -> Jokes -> Table of Contents -> Conclusion
Findings -> Executive Summary -> Goodbye
complex.explanation: Urutan kanonikal laporan formal: Ringkasan Eksekutif $\rightarrow$ Pendahuluan $\rightarrow$ Metodologi $\rightarrow$ Temuan $\rightarrow$ Pembahasan $\rightarrow$ Rekomendasi.
hints: Urutan standar laporan investigasi formal.
Pilih opsi Executive Summary -> Introduction -> Methodology...

complex.prompt: Email etiquette in crisis communications: When communicating a data breach to enterprise clients, the opening paragraph should:
options: immediately disclose the nature and containment of the incident without deflection or evasive euphemisms
blame third-party vendors and downplay the severity
start with a promotional pitch about new product upgrades
complex.explanation: Komunikasi krisis profesional menuntut transparansi cepat, fakta konkret mengenai penahanan insiden (containment), dan empati tanpa penghindaran tanggung jawab.
hints: Transparansi langsung dan penanganan insiden yang jelas.
Pilih opsi immediately disclose the nature and containment.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat resolusi rekomendasi laporan audit.
complex.targetSentence: Management should allocate capital to strengthen internal cybersecurity infrastructure.
complex.explanation: Management should allocate capital + to strengthen internal cybersecurity infrastructure.
hints: Subjek: 'Management should allocate capital'.
Tujuan: 'to strengthen internal cybersecurity infrastructure'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi penutup email yang terlalu santai untuk komunikasi ke dewan komisaris.
options: Respectfully submitted, Johnathan Vance, Senior Vice President.
Thanks a ton, John.
Catch you later, John.
complex.explanation: Untuk dokumen formal kepada dewan komisaris, penutup harus mencerminkan rasa hormat dan jabatan resmi: 'Respectfully submitted, Johnathan Vance, Senior Vice President'.
hints: Penutup formal kepada dewan komisaris.
Pilih 'Respectfully submitted, Johnathan Vance...'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence formulating a diplomatic conditional escalation in commercial correspondence:
options: In the absence of a response by Friday close of business, we shall have no alternative but to reassign the territory.
If you don't reply by Friday we take the area back.
Reply until Friday or else you lose it.
complex.explanation: 'In the absence of a response by [date/time], we shall have no alternative but to...' adalah formula eskalasi diplomatis standar korporasi multinasional.
hints: Formula eskalasi diplomatis korporat multinasional.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog penyusunan laporan kelayakan ekonomi.
dialogue: Lead Consultant
How should we frame the cost-benefit analysis in the report conclusion?
Partner
State that the projected return on investment outweighs the capital expenditure by a ratio of ___.
options: three to one over the designated five-year horizon
many dollars to fewer dollars
lots of profit
complex.explanation: Presisi numerik dan jangka waktu ('three to one over the designated five-year horizon') mencerminkan standar laporan konsultasi manajemen papan atas.
hints: Presisi rasio finansial terukur dengan horison waktu.
Pilih 'three to one over the designated five-year horizon'.

complex.prompt: Examine Crisis Communication best practices when the exact root cause of a service outage is still under investigation: which sentence avoids premature liability while reassuring clients?
options: While our engineering team has already restored primary access, a comprehensive root-cause analysis is underway and will be shared within 24 hours.
It was definitely our new database vendor's terrible fault, and we promise nothing can ever go wrong again.
We have no clue what broke or when anything might ever be fixed.
complex.explanation: Dalam komunikasi krisis korporat tingkat lanjut, jangan langsung menyalahkan vendor maupun berjanji mustahil ('never go wrong again'); nyatakan status pemulihan saat ini, investigasi berjalan, dan komitmen jadwal pembaruan berikutnya.
hints: Komunikasi krisis profesional menyatakan fakta terverifikasi + langkah pemulihan + jadwal update.
Hindari menyalahkan pihak lain tanpa audit atau bersikap panik.

complex.prompt: When issuing a formal final payment notice (elevating firmness without losing legal dignity), which phrasing sets explicit escalation steps cleanly?
options: Should payment remain outstanding beyond October 30, we will be obliged to suspend account privileges in accordance with Clause 11.
Pay your overdue invoice right now or we will ruin your company reputation everywhere!
Please maybe think about paying whenever you happen to find spare cash.
complex.explanation: Menggunakan inversi kondisional sopan ('Should payment remain outstanding beyond [date]') + konsekuensi faktual merujuk klausul kontrak ('we will be obliged to...') menjaga kewibawaan hukum surat resmi.
hints: Gunakan bahasa kontraktual objektif berbasis tanggal batas dan klausul.
Hindari ancaman emosional maupun nada terlalu memohon.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan pengurutan informasi dan gaya laporan eksekutif yang mencampur rekomendasi mentah di dalam bagian metodologi berikut.
complex.draft: Methodology: Staff interviewed forty retail suppliers, and therefore management should immediately replace all paper invoices with QR billing next Monday.
options: Methodology: Staff interviewed forty structured retail suppliers across four provinces to identify invoicing bottlenecks.
Methodology: Staff interviewed forty retail suppliers, so obviously paper invoices are awful and must go immediately.
Findings and Methodology: Replacing paper invoices is the main methodology of our interview with forty suppliers.
complex.explanation: Kesalahan struktur laporan yang serius adalah menaruh rekomendasi tindakan ('management should immediately replace...') di dalam bagian METHODOLOGY; bagian Methodology hanya menjelaskan siapa, bagaimana, dan cakupan pengumpulan data.
hints: Bagian 'Methodology' harus netral menjelaskan proses riset, bukan memberi rekomendasi kebijakan.
Simpan rekomendasi untuk bagian akhir 'Recommendations'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan manajerial mengenai nada diplomatis saat mengoreksi kesalahan klien eksternal.
dialogue: Account Lead
The client forgot to include their tax ID on the PO, delaying shipment. How do I phrase that without sounding accusatory?
Director
Use impersonal framing focused on the document rather than 'you forgot': '___.'
options: To complete customs clearance, could you kindly provide your updated tax ID number?
Because you carelessly forgot your tax ID again, your crate is stuck.
Your mistake on the purchase order stopped our warehouse from shipping.
complex.explanation: Dalam email profesional, menghindari kata ganti tuduhan 'you forgot / your mistake' dan memfokuskan permintaan pada persyaratan proses ('To complete customs clearance, could you kindly provide...') mencegah defensivitas penerima.
hints: Fokus pada proses dan solusi ke depan, bukan menyalahkan kelalaian penerima.
Hilangkan kata tuduhan 'you forgot / your mistake'.

complex.prompt: Note how Executive Summaries differ from Introductions in formal reports: an Executive Summary MUST provide ___ upfront for time-pressed decision makers.
options: a concise distillation of purpose, key findings, conclusions, and main recommendations
only a vague teaser withholding the conclusions until Page 40
every single raw interview transcript in full
complex.explanation: Berbeda dari 'Introduction' yang hanya membuka topik, 'Executive Summary' adalah versi mini utuh laporan yang langsung memaparkan temuan inti dan rekomendasi di halaman awal.
hints: Executive Summary memberi gambaran lengkap hasil & rekomendasi untuk pembaca eksekutif yang sibuk.
Jangan menahan kesimpulan di Executive Summary.

complex.prompt: Which sentence handles third-party reference cleanly inside a formal recommendation report?
options: Based on the comparative cost model outlined in Appendix C, centralizing cold-chain dispatch yields an estimated 14% annual saving.
Looking at what I scribbled in Appendix C, centralizing stuff saves around 14% or so.
Appendix C basically tells us that we should probably centralize dispatch maybe.
complex.explanation: Merujuk ke lampiran dengan frasa partisipel/preposisional presisi ('Based on the comparative cost model outlined in Appendix C,') menunjukkan ketelitian analitis laporan.
hints: Padukan rujukan lampiran spesifik dan angka estimasi yang jernih.
Hindari 'scribbled', 'stuff', atau ketidakpastian 'probably ... maybe'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan klaim hukum 'without prejudice' atau penutup lampiran yang klise berikut.
complex.draft: Enclosed herewith please find attached the above-mentioned signed affidavit of the same.
options: Please find attached the signed affidavit referenced above.
Please find enclosed herewith attached the same signed affidavit.
Herewith find attached the above-said affidavit of the same.
complex.explanation: Menumpuk klise birokratis usang ('Enclosed herewith please find attached... above-mentioned... of the same') adalah gaya kuno bertele-tele; ganti dengan kalimat modern yang bersih dan profesional ('Please find attached the signed affidavit referenced above').
hints: Hindari tumpukan kata usang 'herewith', 'above-mentioned', 'of the same'.
Gunakan formula modern yang ringkas dan jelas.

complex.prompt: In formal stakeholder apologies after an operational error, pairing ownership with concrete remediation is crucial: 'We take full responsibility for this dispatch error and ___ a complimentary express replacement at zero cost.'
options: have already dispatched
will think about maybe sending
cannot confirm whether anyone cares to send
complex.explanation: Permintaan maaf bisnis yang kredibel menyatakan tanggung jawab penuh lalu langsung menyebutkan tindakan perbaikan nyata yang sudah diambil ('have already dispatched').
hints: Tunjukkan tindakan korektif nyata, bukan keraguan.
Pilih 'have already dispatched'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat eskalasi tagihan resmi yang tetap diplomatis memakai inversi 'Should'.
complex.targetSentence: Should unforeseen delays affect your transfer schedule, please notify our finance desk before Friday.
complex.explanation: Pembuka inversi 'Should...' memperhalus nada komunikasi batas waktu pembayaran.
hints: Awali dengan 'Should unforeseen delays affect your transfer schedule,'.
Lanjutkan permintaan pemberitahuan yang sopan.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat rekomendasi laporan bertingkat menggunakan konstruksi pasif 'is proposed'.
complex.targetSentence: A phased pilot across two regional depots is proposed prior to full national rollout.
complex.explanation: Rekomendasi kebijakan dengan 'is proposed prior to...' menjaga objektivitas nada eksekutif.
hints: Mulai dengan 'A phased pilot across two regional depots is proposed'.
Akhiri dengan 'prior to full national rollout'.
